thread:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync: need one canonical partner SEV path that covers marketplace listings, field HW failures, and SI-install issues. Minimal, actionable, with fallbacks.

Jon (Support): +1. Proposed minimal actions in shared channel: Start War Room, Escalate Oncall, Mark Partner Visible. Buttons preferred, but we need fallbacks.

Aiko (HW Partner Eng): For colo HW failures we need phone escalation option. Suggest three-tier trigger: buttons -> reaction /slash -> phone. Phone requires serial confirmation.

Sam (SI Ops): SIs often block external Slack. Recommend email subject format so our parser can auto-create a bridge: SUBJECT: [PSEV] Partner=Voltix Cust=Acme Impact=auth-timeouts. Reply will include join link.

Maya (Partnerships): Good. Also: mark who initiated (partner|si|internal) in the payload and add partner_tier so routing can pick dedicated capacity.

alert-bot: automation-check OK for #partners-voltix. reaction-trigger enabled.

Jon (Support): Fallbacks to accept as equivalent: 1) reaction :rotating_light: on the pinned triage message, 2) /partner-sev slash with minimal fields, 3) email parser. All create same audit event and correlation id.

Aiko (HW Partner Eng): Two-step confirm for phone path to avoid accidental pages. Also request hw_serial + fw_version in initial triage for hardware incidents.

Sam (SI Ops): Add consent line for sharing logs in email template and link to policy: https://policies.redwood.example/data-sharing

Maya (Partnerships): Action items: Jon to update escalation matrix and pin message; Aiko to supply phone oncall list and confirm flow; Sam to publish SI email template; Maya to publish one-pager and schedule 20-min walkthrough.

Jon (Support): Will do.

Maya (Partnerships): Scheduling walkthrough for Tue 09:30 PT. ops-bot: please create event.

alert-bot: Event created: "Partner SEV quickwalk" 2025-03-04 09:30 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.example/psv-quickwalk

Maya (Partnerships): Thanks team — will post the pinned cheat-sheet after the walkthrough. :thumbsup:
